title: Conversion Rate Optimization & Landing Page Friction Audit

sections.executiveSummary: Post-click conversion funnel audit analyzing landing page speed, UX, and form completion rates.
sections.overallScore: CRO Index (0-100) combining Mobile Core Web Vitals, checkout step drop-off, and conversion friction.
sections.findings: Landing page performance benchmarks, mobile responsiveness, and CTA visual salience analysis.
sections.issues: Identified high bounce rates (>65%), slow Largest Contentful Paint (LCP > 2.5s), and checkout friction.
sections.recommendations: Technical and UX optimizations to accelerate page load and simplify conversion actions.
sections.priorityMatrix: Development effort vs revenue uplift prioritization matrix.
sections.actionPlan: A/B testing roadmap for headline copy, form field reductions, and mobile speed optimizations.
sections.supportingEvidence: PageSpeed Insights scores, Core Web Vitals metrics (LCP, FID, CLS), and funnel step drop-off data.
sections.appendix: Tested destination URLs, device breakdowns, and browser compatibility notes.
